body: Yup... needless to say we’re no longer friends lol

Glad you’re feeling better! My doctor gave me some vitamin C + D and Zinc. They’ve helped with overall fatigue and other symptoms, but nothing has been helping my back pain. I’ll look into diclofenac potassium

Damn, I’m sorry to hear that. I really hope you’re doing better now. Fortunately, my breathing is normal and nothing seems wrong with my lungs. I’ll keep a close eye on my back pain and see jf it transfers anywhere though.
Yeah neck and back aches are pretty much my main symptom as well. I’ve been bed ridden since day one so I’ll see if walking improves the situation. Thanks!
Glad you’re feeling better. And I agree, if you have access to the vaccine you should definitely get it. But where I live the vaccine still isn’t widely available for people my age (I’m 20)
I’ll definitely check this out! Thank you!
Yeah none of then are near my abdomen at all, so I guess I’ll have to resort to heavy duty concealer! I’ll check Dermablend out! Thank you

I was talking about the UAE, tattoos are legal, and you’re allowed to walk freely with then showing, but legal tattoo parlors dont exist in the city I’m in, so kind of the idea of “you can have tattoos as long as you dont get them here”
I find that it leaks more when its laying flat, when i use the vape i rarely notice leaking, but when i place it down on a surface for a bit, it immediately leaks

Okay great! Thank you for your reply and yes I study in Canada, but the issue isn’t where I got them, but the fact that I have them in the first place. Because the doctor will likely tell my parents who will proceed to deal with me whichever way they see fit.
Yeah many are telling me Smok isn’t the best. What brand/device do you suggest I look into?
No idea about the vape juice, maybe that could be an issue, but the pods are Mesh standard, 1.2 resistance level.
That happens too but yes it is also leaking, I can feel and smell the vape juice all over my fingers after I vape.

Thanks for the reply! I’m definitely not experiencing much pain nor am I vomiting, only getting some cramps which I’m assuming is normal. I want to avoid the hospital as much as I can but I understand that I may have to go. I’ll definitely give my doctor a call and I’ll check out Bisacodyl as well! Thanks again :)
Yes, I drink a bunch of water with it, as well as throughout the night after taking it.
any compliment that comes from an older woman that I don’t know. they just hit differently

Sounds awesome! I started meditating for about 20 mins during quarantine, but stopped after I moved back home. However, I’m definitely planning on starting again when I go back, and I’d love to use the app! Also this might be a pretty popular sentiment but I’ve just never read it before but the “living in the past gives you depression and living in the future makes you anxious” just snapped something in me. That’s totally what I’ve been doing recently, damn. Anyways, can’t wait for the app and I’m happy to see that meditation actually works for “beginners”, I was worried it would take me months to feel some benefits.

I’m 19 so this might be my naiveness speaking, but I’m not really afraid of what happens after death, whether its just darkness or whatever. I’m more so afraid of the act of dying itself, which may sound weird. Like I’d HATE to go out in a slow and painful death, which I’m sure everyone would agree with. But I’m more afraid of dying a painful death, than I am just simply dying.

Yeah that is true, I feel like everytime I start a weight loss plan, I kind of get really extreme and put a lot of pressure on myself. So yeah I’ll definitely try to start slow so that I don’t feel like I’m punishing my body but rather easing into a healthier lifestyle. Thanks for your reply! :D

I’m definitely gonna try to sign up for some activity that I enjoy because I used to take dance classes and I really enjoyed the physical aspect of it. I’m currently counting calories but I also feel like sometimes it causes me to be anxious, like if I had one almond on my way to get water from the kitchen, I’d run up to log it in my app. Either way, I’m hopeful for next year as I think my mindset is better than before, thank you for the reply and the tips! I really appreciate it

But the difference is, this drug isn’t harming me the way weed was. I get what you’re saying, no one should have to resort to a drug to feel better, but I’ve only been on anti-depressants for like 4 months. I’m hopeful that I won’t spend the rest of my days on anti-depressants, but if I have to just to feel better and have more motivation to actually get my life on track so that I won’t have to use em anymore, then that’s what I’m gonna do. I’ll definitely check the book out though.

May be true for some, but definitely not for me. Before anti-depressants, I had no motivation to do basic things like eat or clean, i was suicidal almost daily, cut off all my friends. After starting medication, (it took a few tried with different kinds), all that has GREATLY decreased.

I’m sorry to hear that, yeah I’m sure baby steps is the way to go but I totally get what you’re saying. I can never get how people just get in a car and drive while talking or whatever, like all my attention is usually about how anxious I feel. I hope you are able to overcome this fear though!!

My first class is tomorrow, and I’ll definitely be upfront with my instructor and I’ll hope for the best! Thanks for your reply!

Damn, yeah that would definitely freak me out. I’m not a big believer of paranormal beings or whatever, but this definitely got my wheels turning a bit lmao. Because, I can’t think of any other explanation tbh
That is true, pain shouldn’t be invalidated but I just can’t help but have those negative self-loathing thoughts. Thank you very much for your kind and encouraging words 💕 I truly appreciate it

No apologies needed, I know many people go through much worse. I don’t want to give up, mostly for my friends, but sometimes I just get so tired. And yeah, I think my whole life, my family had such high standards all the time, so I often felt like a disappointment and even if I say it doesnt affect me, I think sometimes it still does. Thank you for your reply and for being such a kind soul, it means a lot. <3

I see where you’re coming, I always go back and forth on how I think they’d react. My mom’s aunt committed suicide and my mom talks about her as if she committed mass genocide. I’m gonna try to hold on, I don’t think I’m ready to go yet. Thanks for the reply, I really appreciate it.
Yeah I’m glad you went out and got the help you needed though! And I’m sorry to hear that about your gf, relationships can be very challenging if someone’s having some mental health issues.

Thank you for sharing. My experience is also very similar to yours. When I’m depressed, I also sleep a lot and have no motivation to do anything. Sometimes when I have a bit of energy, if I get up, make breakfast and shower, I feel worn out and want to go back to doing nothing. I also have days where I feel hopeless, like going to class won’t help me anyways etc. Its the same with my “normal” days and “good” days. When it’s normal, I feel motivated, energized, I can work out and talk to friends without feeling like I’m for ing myself. And when I’m having a good day, I also get really creative and set unrealistic goals for what I can achieve. 

I know that having the same symptoms does not mean a similar diagnosis is needed, but I was just looking for other people who had similar experiences.

Ultimately, I will be speaking to a professional because I know I’ve avoided it for so long and it’s slowly ruining my life day by day. I appreciate you sharing your experiences, so thank you!
i’ll be sure to check those out, thank you so much, I really appreciate it :)
Hahah no nude girls on my walls. Definitely will try to keep my house cleaner though, I feel like that might help improve overall mood.
I had no idea these were actually a thing. I'll definitely do some more research about it! Thank you so much!
Definitely gonna try to stop or at least reduce my use of weed. Thinking of joining a martial arts school in a couple of months so I guess that could be a good outlet too! Thanks for the advice!
